title: ageratina aristei
intro: Ageratina aristei, commonly known as Mexican mint hill or Mexican sage, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina aristei include sedation, pain relief, and the reduction of inflammation and spasms, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes. Research on Ageratina aristei is ongoing, but initial findings suggest potential uses in the management of conditions like insomnia, anxiety, and muscle spasms.
